stories.title: Flintshire Council adopts plan to modernise services after public consultation
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has signed off a three-year plan setting out how it will change the way its services are run, after making changes based on residents’ feedback. stories.title: Flintshire slips 10 places in UK economic league table as Cheshire West climbs 41
stories.summary: Flintshire has dropped 10 places in a UK league table of local economies, while neighbouring Cheshire West and Chester has climbed 41. The UK Competitiveness Index 2026 puts Flintshire 158th of 349 council areas in Great Britain, down from 148th in 2022. Its score fell from 95.1 to 94.1, where 100 is the UK average.

stories.title: HMRC warns of fake tax refund scams ahead of 31 January Self Assessment deadline
stories.summary: HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) is warning anyone filing a Self Assessment tax return to watch out for fake tax refund offers as the 31 January deadline gets closer.
